title: ProjectedRelation
description: A relation admitted (or not) into a graph projection for a specific time, profile, and admission policy. The projection is the time-indexed edge set over which path traversal operates. `admitted` reflects the admission policy applied to the relation's evidential state; when false, `exclusionReason` explains why.

evidentialState.description: The computed evidential state at the projection's time/profile.

admitted.description: Whether the relation is admitted into the projection under the admission policy.

exclusionReason.description: Human-readable reason when the relation is not admitted.
